Owner

Summary

Addresses 150 reported SonarCloud issues: 9 are fixed in code, and 141 diagnostics are suppressed with documented justifications.

Type of change

  • Refactoring
  • Tests

Changes

  • Fixed in code (9): IDE0028 (2), CA1854 (1, AnyDateTimeOffset), CA1865 (3), SYSLIB1045 (2, [GeneratedRegex]), xUnit1044 (1: the Func is resolved by case name rather than passed through TheoryData).
  • Suppressed with NetAnalyzersRule (5): CA2249 (3, string.Contains(char) is absent downlevel) and CA1069 (2, the aliased enum is the subject of the test).
  • Suppressed with JustDummiesRule (136): JD029 (39), JD030 (72), JD031 (3), JD033 (22). The library's own analyzers report on tests whose subject is the very behaviour the rule describes. Each suppression sits on the enclosing member.
  • Shared justifications live in each project's SuppressionJustification (one nested class per rule). JustDummies.Xunit.UnitTests gains a reference to JustDummies.DiagnosticCatalog and its own SuppressionJustification.cs.
  • The JD031 justification in JustDummies.PropertyTests is guarded by #if NET8_0_OR_GREATER, because its only users are excluded from the net472 leg.
  • No public API change. The only library change is the TryGetValue rewrite in AnyDateTimeOffset, which does not alter behaviour.

Testing

  • dotnet build JustDummies.sln — 0 warnings, 0 errors (net10.0; the net472 leg was not built locally)
  • dotnet test --solution JustDummies.sln — 2873 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed (net10.0)
  • Analyzer tests pass (JustDummies.Analyzers.UnitTests, run as part of the solution)

The remaining SonarCloud issue count is pending verification by the SonarQube Cloud analysis workflow.

Documentation

  • No documentation change required

Architecture decisions

  • No architectural decision in this pull request

Related issues

None.

chore (blocking): PR title and description need accurate English.

[P2] The summary says that 15 issues were fixed in code and 135 suppressed, but the breakdown in this very description totals 9 code fixes (IDE0028: 2; CA1854: 1; CA1865: 3; SYSLIB1045: 2; xUnit1044: 1) and 141 suppressed diagnostics (CA2249: 3; CA1069: 2; JD029: 39; JD030: 72; JD031: 3; JD033: 22). These figures should agree, or the description should explain a different counting convention.

[P2] “The Sonar analysis itself has not been re-run; the new issue count is confirmed by the CI run on this PR” is misleading: the PR triggers a dedicated SonarQube Cloud analysis workflow, which is currently still running. A passing build/test workflow cannot verify the number of remaining SonarCloud issues. State that the issue count is pending verification by the Sonar analysis instead.

[P3] The title “suppress them by catalogue” and “instead of travelling through TheoryData” read like literal translations rather than idiomatic English.

Suggested targeted wording:

  • Title: refactor: address SonarCloud findings and document suppressions
  • Summary: “Addresses 150 reported SonarCloud issues: 9 are fixed in code, and 141 diagnostics are suppressed with documented justifications.”
  • xUnit1044 change: “The Func is resolved by case name rather than passed through TheoryData.”
  • Testing: “Build and tests pass. The remaining SonarCloud issue count must be confirmed after the SonarQube Cloud analysis finishes.”
